title: Hard Rock Cafe Myrtle Beach
includes: Beverage: choice of soft drink, coffee or tea
One meal per person based on menu selected
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a prix-fixe menu at the Myrtle Beach Hard Rock Cafe. Classic American cooking comes to the beach, where you’ll enjoy a 2- or 3-course meal with your choice of theme. Each option comes with a drink (coffee, tea or soda) and dessert. Expect entrees like the classic cheeseburger, a half-rack of hickory-smoked ribs, salmon, steak and even some vegetarian options. Love all - Serve all!
